msg: (A) the susceptance null IS the best setting: RL at the null minus RL at 0.90x the null total C = +7.41 dB. This underwrites the 'trimmer at its best setting' premise of s11_band.cir and s11_corners.cir, which is otherwise an assertion.
(A) same test 10% ABOVE the null: +7.41 dB. Symmetric with dopt_m10 to 5 decimal places, which is what a true minimum of |Gamma| looks like.
(A) 0.80x the null total C costs 12.79 dB.
(A) 1.25x the null total C costs 14.65 dB.
(B) at L = lnull_lo with the trimmer pinned at its 1 pF LOW stop the null is real, not clamped: 75.75 dB. Residual is Reff = 50 + X^2/R only.

(B) at L = lnull_hi with the trimmer at its 35 pF TOP stop the null is still real, and RL = 26.61 dB - i.e. the top of the perfect-null range is ALSO within a whisker of the 26 dB spec limit, by coincidence of this trimmer range.

(B) README NUMBER: the smallest L_launch a 1 pF trimmer + 1.3 pF pad can null exactly = 5.752 nH. The architect's 6.9 nH budget sits just above it, so the nominal board tunes to a true null with 1.15 nH to spare.
(B) README NUMBER: the largest L_launch a 35 pF trimmer + 1.3 pF pad can null exactly = 99.64 nH.
(B) the same low endpoint as series reactance at 25.0 MHz: 0.904 ohm.
(B) the same high endpoint as series reactance at 25.0 MHz: 15.652 ohm.
(B) README NUMBER - achievable adjustment range, perfect-null definition: 93.89 nH (5.752 to 99.64 nH).
(B) the same span as reactance: 14.748 ohm (0.904 to 15.652 ohm at 25.0 MHz).

(C) L = 1 pH, i.e. NO launch inductance at all: 40.89 dB. The trimmer cannot back below 1 pF so it over-corrects by 2.3 pF of susceptance, and even that costs only 33 dB of headroom. Spec is met with the launch inductance completely absent.
(C) L = 6.9 nH, the architect's budget: 72.58 dB.
(C) L = 90 nH: 28.31 dB - 13x the architect's budget and still 2.3 dB of margin.
(C) L = 100 nH: 26.55 dB. The trimmer is hard against its 35 pF stop here (the ideal null needs 36.4 pF), so this is a clamped best-effort setting, not a true null.
(C) L = 102 nH: 26.21 dB - the last gridded point above spec with real margin.

(C) L = 103 nH: 26.035 dB. Tight bracket, warning severity by design: this pins the upper edge of the spec-authority range to 0.035 dB, which is finer than any bound should be allowed to fail a gate on.
(C) L = 104 nH: 25.858 dB - below spec. With rl_l103 this brackets the README NUMBER: RL >= 26 dB holds up to L = 103-104 nH (closed form 103.20 nH), X = 16.18-16.34 ohm.
(C) L = 105 nH: 25.68 dB. Past the adjustment range - and no trimmer setting recovers it (reff_limit.cir).

HARD SPEC ON THE TRIMMER RE-SELECTION (blocks.md s8 OPEN-1 is re-picking the part for temperature): nulling the 6.9 nH budget launch needs 1.459 pF of TRIMMER on top of the 1.3 pF pad parasitic. A candidate whose low stop is above 1.46 pF cannot null the nominal board at all - which is exactly what the incumbent BFC280811339 (3 pF min) does, missing it by 1.5 pF.
same for the pessimistic 8.4 nH launch: 2.058 pF of trimmer. A 2 pF-minimum part would just barely null this one and not the nominal one.

how far the swept trimmer's low stop sits BELOW the nominal requirement: +0.459 pF with cmin = 1 pF. Warning, not error, because a bottomed-out trimmer is not a spec failure here - at cmin = 3 pF the nominal build still reads 44 dB - it only costs the two-sided null that requirements crit. 5 asks for (blocks.md s8 OPEN-3).
